faqs.question: How quickly can we deploy Aegix across our clusters?
faqs.answer: Deployment takes less than 60 seconds with our standard Helm chart or single curl command. Because Aegix leverages native Linux eBPF, it requires zero sidecar containers and zero application restarts.

faqs.question: Does Aegix add CPU overhead or latency to production traffic?
faqs.answer: No. Aegix operates directly in kernel ring-0 using compiled eBPF bytecode. Its footprint is strictly capped at under 0.2% CPU utilization and adds zero detectable network latency.

faqs.question: How does the 14-day free trial work?
faqs.answer: All plans come with an unrestricted 14-day trial. You get full access to all cognitive heuristic detection modules, global Anycast scrubbing, and live forensics with no credit card required upfront.

faqs.question: Which regulatory compliance frameworks are supported?
faqs.answer: Aegix is certified for SOC2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI-DSS Level 1, and GDPR. All forensic logs are cryptographically sealed with hardware-attested post-quantum signatures.

faqs.question: Can we upgrade or downgrade our plan at any time?
faqs.answer: Yes. Billing automatically prorates immediately. If you scale nodes up during high-traffic events, Aegix automatically accommodates burst capacity without interrupting your defense mesh.
